question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word. **
solution:
The correct answer is '**Ocupant**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options, the incorrectly spelt word is '**Ocupant**'.
 
• Its correct spelling is '**Occupant**'.
 
• It means** 'a person who is in a building, car, etc. at a particular time; the holder of a position or office.** (समय विशेष में किसी भवन में रहने वाला, कार में बैठा हुआ (आदि) व्यक्ति, दख़लकार, अधिभोक्ता; निवासी)'.
 
 
• *Example: You may want to talk to the **occupant** as well, he said*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Abdicate**: to give up being King or Queen. (सम्राट या साम्राज्ञी के पद का त्‍याग करना)
 
• **Rampant**: (used about something bad) existing or spreading everywhere in a way that is very difficult to control. [(बुरी चीज़ों का) अनियंत्रित रूप से सर्वत्र विद्यमान होना या फैलना]
 
• **Academic**: connected with education, especially in schools and universities. (शिक्षा से संबंधित, विशेषतया स्‍कूलों और विश्‍वविद्यालयों की शिक्षा से; शैक्षिक)
